reviews.reason: This item combines parsing scope, storage integrations, OCR, a separate service reference, and deployment options in one chain. Separating these functions would clarify their relationships while retaining all-model support, formats, providers, the link, and deployment details.

The length largely comes from two useful enumerations: supported search engines and search controls. The SearXNG basis and the lists remain readily identifiable; sentence length alone does not establish a useful correction.

This is a backend-capability inventory under one feature heading. Its length reflects the number of settings and management functions, not a difficult sequence of clauses; splitting it would primarily change list presentation.

The nested explanation moves from enabling caching to hash matching, prior requests, returned results, billing, and request reduction, with ambiguous uses of 'it.' Clearer sentence boundaries can reduce that burden while preserving the matching condition and the no-billing rule for cache hits.

Most of this item's length comes from a capability list and necessary definitions distinguishing priority from weight among channels at the same priority. The long-sentence diagnosis does not identify a problem with that list structure; the promotional wording is a separate issue.

The sentence shifts from settings synchronizing to implied instructions to modify and build a site, then ends in benefit fragments. This makes the actor and sequence hard to follow. A repair can retain the synchronized settings, subsequent customization, and one-click launch emphasis.

The comma chain mixes supported code types, batch generation, distinct sales and promotion uses, and a redemption restriction. Separating these functions would make the operational rule easier to find while preserving one code per user per gift-code type and the qualified promotional benefit.

The item presents a single limitation, its consequence for channels at the same priority, and a linked alternative. The open-source qualification, weight parameter, and New API parenthetical are meaningful parts of the comparison; length alone does not make their relationship difficult to follow.

The sentence carries the combined product objective across a line break into a chain of audience and business benefits. Separating the objective from the intended outcomes would reduce clause tracking while retaining both user and business audiences and the aspirational nature of the benefits.
